Name: Krobus Dialogue Mod Pack for SVE 1.6
Author: MelindaC
Description:
[size=5][b][u]Overview:

[/u][/b][/size]The Krobus Dialogue Mod Pack for SVE contains the following:

- Krobus Dialogue Mod for SVE
- Krobus Marriage Dialogue Mod for SVE

[size=5][b][u]Requirements:

[/u][/b][/size]The Krobus Dialogue Mod Pack requires the following:

- Content Patcher for both versions.
- Stardew Valley Expanded for both versions.
- Canon-Friendly Dialogue Expansion for both versions.

Canon-Friendly Dialogue Expansion is required to ensure that both Krobus Dialogue Mod for SVE versions will load last making it a priority for SMAPI. 

[size=5][b][u]Troubleshooting:

[/u][/b][/size]- Make sure you have all the required mods and that they're up-to-date.
- Please note that Krobus will start with basic dialogue and then gradually open up about his experiences, likes, beliefs and fears from two hearts onward. After six hearts his dialogue would be more SVE immersive as you should have seen his six-heart event as it takes place right in the sewers.
- If you are not married to Krobus, please install only the Krobus Dialogue Mod for SVE. If you are already married to Krobus, install the Krobus Marriage Dialogue Mod for SVE. If you are not yet married to Krobus and planning on doing it, you can install both.
- Please note that I am not responsible for Content Patcher, Stardew Valley Expanded and Canon-Friendly Dialogue Expansion. If you have any errors or questions relating to these mods I ask that you contact the author or make a post on their pages.
- For technical issues, a link to your SMAPI log will be most beneficial. You can find instructions [url=http://smapi.io/log]here.[/url]﻿ For coding issues, a screenshot would be appreciated. 

[size=5][b][u]Compatibility:

[/u][/b][/size]- Please note that there are very few dialogue mods featuring Krobus so any chance of conflict is very small. Stardew Valley Expanded itself does not edit any dialogue from the basic characters except for some cutscenes.
- I have tested this mod using the Community Centre route. I don't think Krobus' character would change greatly if you chose the Joja route but do let me know of any developments.
- Android users should note that SVE is not compatible with the current version of Android. If you want a general dialogue mod for Krobus for Android check the link below.
- If you're not using SVE and want a more general Krobus dialogue mod, check my Krobus Dialogue Mod Pack [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6760]here.[/url]﻿
- And yes, you can edit any dialogue but make a backup as any update would restore the original dialogue.
